chat_name: Memo: Larkspur new-money memo / Checklist consolidation
prompt:
UNDERWRITER TO COMPLETE CHECKLIST: 45 items in the memo, 38 after grouping by code.

Group: Documents to request
1. (Section 1) Expansion Project: the term has the meaning given in Schedule 1.1, which is not in the excerpt [D2, §1.1]. The Schedule 1.1 definition.
2. (Section 1) Revolver purpose: the documents do not state the intended use of the revolver beyond D2 §2.1(c). The revolver draw plan (borrower request letter or term sheet).
3. (Section 2) **Waiver W-25-0117:** D5 ¶3 refers only to "the reporting covenant." The waiver document and the existing 2023 credit agreement section it relates to; these would normally be held by Credit Administration or the loan file.
4. (Section 2) The borrower's legal form and state of incorporation, and management biographies beyond the names and roles above. The corporate records or the full credit file would normally hold these.
5. (Section 4) Confirmation that the spread's EBITDA, capex, debt service and funded debt match the D2 definitions, including the capital lease obligations in "Total Funded Debt" and the GAAP-based EBITDA. The covenant definitions, a covenant compliance calculation, or the full draft agreement would normally contain this.
6. (Section 4) How the pro forma debt service of 5,600 was built. The spread's FY2025 model or amortization schedule would normally contain this.
7. (Section 4) **Event of Default provisions.** No other Events of Default (payment, cross-default, cure periods) appear in the excerpt. The full Events of Default article of the draft agreement.
8. (Section 4) **Existing agreement terms.** The existing 2023 credit agreement, including its reporting deadlines, any capex covenant and negative pledge. The waiver W-25-0117 document is also not provided, so the covenant it waived and its terms are unconfirmed beyond D5 ¶3.
9. (Section 4) **Existing liens and purchase-money debt.** A lien search or schedule of existing liens and purchase-money indebtedness against the $1,000,000 basket in §7.5(b)(iii). A UCC search or the closing checklist would normally contain this.
10. (Section 5) Collateral valuation, lien position and guarantor support: Appraisal or valuation of the Rockford plant or other collateral; Collateral coverage or loan-to-value figures; Lien search, title or UCC results confirming first-priority position; Erik Halvorsen's financial statements, net worth or liquidity; Collateral and guaranty terms of the existing 2023 credit agreement; The definition of "Expansion Project." [D3, Part B] [D2, §1.1]
11. (Section 6) The assumptions behind pro forma debt service of 5,600 (interest rate and amortization terms assumed; the D1 spread or pro forma model would normally contain these). D2 gives only the seven-year amortization schedule and five-year maturity of the Term Loan [D2, §2.1(a)].
12. (Section 6) Any Meridian policy provisions outside §4.2 (D4 is an excerpt; the full Commercial Credit Policy would contain them).

Group: Conflicts to resolve
13. (Sections 1, 3, 6) Source discrepancy for Section 3: the Management commentary states net income of "$4.2 million" for FY2025 [D1, §6], while Table 1 shows net income of 3,900 for FY2025 [D1, §1: Net income, FY2025]. CONFLICT. I have not chosen between them. Also cited in the repeats: [D1, Table 1: Net income, FY2025]

Group: Policy items for judgment
14. (Section 1) New-money status: D4 §4.2.3 applies to "new-money" requests [D4, §4.2.3]. The provided documents do not state whether this request is classified as new-money. The underwriter should determine this and any resulting senior review requirement.
15. (Section 1) Policy items for Section 6: the pro forma figures above are relevant to D4 §4.2.1-§4.2.3, and the underwriter applies those tests.
16. (Section 3) Pro forma DSCR is 1.38x [D1, Table 3] against the policy minimum of 1.25x [D4, §4.2.2].
17. (Section 3) Pro forma total leverage is 2.52x [D1, Table 3] against the policy maximum of 3.50x [D4, §4.2.1].
18. (Section 3) Senior review is triggered where total commitment exceeds $15.0 million [D4, §4.2.3(a)]. The proposed commitment is $18.0M [D1, §3: Note to Table 3].
19. (Section 6) **Approval of exceptions:** No exception is identified from the stated figures. A human approves any exception, and the underwriter confirms this conclusion [D3, Part A: Section list, #6].
20. (Section 6) **"New-money" classification:** §4.2.3 applies to "new-money" requests, and D4 does not define the term. The request increases an existing $12.0 million facility to $18.0M, and part of the term loan refinances the existing Meridian term loan of 5,600 [D5, ¶2, ¶4; D1, §3 note]. The underwriter should determine whether the request is new-money for §4.2.3 and which amount counts as "total commitment." Refer this policy interpretation to the underwriter and Credit Policy.
21. (Section 6) **Pro forma basis:** D4 does not define total leverage or DSCR for policy purposes. The pro forma figures use the D1 spread definitions [D1, §2 definitions]. D2 wording differs, for example "Unfinanced Capital Expenditures" in D2 versus "unfunded capex" in D1 [D2, §1.1; D1, §2]. The underwriter should confirm the D1 pro forma figures are the intended basis for the policy tests.

Group: Sections to write
22. (Sections 3, 4) Customer A was 31% of FY2025 revenue [D1, §5]. Policy requires concentration to be addressed in Section 7 when a single customer exceeds 25% [D4, §4.2.4]. Also cited in the repeats: [D1, §5; D4, §4.2.4]
23. (Section 3) **Section 3.5 Underwriter Commentary:** reserved for the underwriter.
24. (Section 6) **Section 7:** The §4.2.4 concentration discussion belongs in Section 7. Section 7 is underwriter-authored. Cited facts the underwriter may need: Customer A at 28% of FY2024 revenue and 31% of FY2025 revenue, and the top five customers at 64% of FY2025 revenue [D1, §5]. Management expects the plant expansion to add capacity for the Customer A program beginning in 2027 [D1, §6]. The borrower also described the expansion as tied to a new multi-year Customer A program [D5, ¶4].

Group: Other checks
25. (Section 1) Header fields: request type, underwriter, senior reviewer and memo date (not in provided documents).
26. (Section 1) Competing offer: the national bank offer is recorded only as the borrower's statement [D5, ¶4]. No term sheet is in the provided documents.
27. (Sections 2, 4) **Change of control (§7.6):** D2 §7.6 makes it an Event of Default if the Founders cease to own "a meaningful portion of the voting equity interests" or cease to be "actively involved in the management of the Borrower." [D2, §7.6] The terms "meaningful portion" and "actively involved" are not defined in the excerpt. Refer them to the underwriter and legal. Whether the CEO transition or a minority stake sale in D5 ¶5 bears on these terms is for the underwriter and legal to determine. Also cited in the repeats: [D2, §1.1; D5, ¶1]
28. (Section 2) **Header fields:** Underwriter, Senior reviewer and Date are not in the provided documents.
29. (Section 3) **Missing FY2025 data:** year-end cash and liquidity are not in the documents. The source is the year-end bank statements due with the Q3 2026 package [D1, §2: Footnote *].
30. (Sections 3, 4) The spread DSCR uses "unfunded capex" and "debt service (P+I)" [D1, §2]. The draft agreement uses "Unfinanced Capital Expenditures" and "scheduled payments of principal and interest on Total Funded Debt" [D2, §1.1]. The spread ratios may not be on the agreement basis. Confirm whether they are comparable.
31. (Section 3) The spread does not state how EBITDA is built. The draft agreement defines EBITDA from GAAP net income [D2, §1.1]. Confirm the spread EBITDA matches.
32. (Section 3) **Pro forma basis:** the pro forma figures are on a FY2025 basis [D1, Table 3]. The pro forma revolver balance of 3,200 [D1, §3: Note to Table 3] sits within a $6.0M revolver commitment [D2, §2.1(b)]. Pro forma revolver availability is not stated in the documents.
33. (Section 4) The spread's ratios are on an annual FY2025 basis [D1, Table 3]. D2 tests quarterly on trailing four quarters [D2, §7.1, §7.2]. No quarterly pro forma is provided.
34. (Section 4) **Schedule 1.1 not provided.** The definition of "Expansion Project" is needed to apply the §7.3 exclusion [D2, §1.1, §7.3]. Other defined terms are in the full draft agreement.
35. (Section 4) **Covenant levels versus requirements.** The covenant levels in D2 are stated alongside the D1 figures without any conclusion on headroom. Any assessment is for the underwriter.
36. (Section 5) **Flag for underwriter and legal (not interpreted here):** D2 §2.2(a) states a first-priority security interest in "all present and future assets of the Borrower." D2 §1.1 and §7.5(b)(ii) state that the Equipment Notes are secured "only by the equipment they finance," and the negative pledge permits those Liens. The draft does not state how the first-priority grant interacts with the Equipment Notes liens or the purchase-money Liens in §7.5(b)(iii). Refer to the underwriter and legal.
37. (Section 5) **Guaranty scope:** The guaranty is described as "limited" with recourse "capped at $3,000,000 in the aggregate." The excerpt does not state whether the guaranty is of payment or collection, or whether it covers principal, interest or costs. Refer to legal.
38. (Section 5) **Underwriter judgment:** Any assessment of collateral adequacy or guarantor support, and any treatment of the other shareholders as guarantors, is for the underwriter.
